method: Read the team brief and plan (newsroom.sgit.ai) and sgit.ai/llms.txt for who we are (sgit vaults, RiskMandate Agent Behaviour Policies, SHarness, the newsroom API). Then read the server-rendered HTML of websummit.com (robots.txt allows all but /api/): the 2026 event partners page (first 40 partners embedded in the page), the featured startups page (first 100, alphabetical A to Su, all GROWTH), the speakers and featured attendees pages (first 20 each), the schedule page (first sessions), and the track pages. Each entry carries conferenceSlug "lis26", which is what makes it a 2026 confirmation; each links to a public /appearances/lis26/<id>/<slug> or /attendees/lis26/<id>/<slug> page, from which the company website was read. The rest of each list is loaded client-side from a search service and was NOT read (see notes). Added press (Lusa via AMAN, Fast Company ME, The Portugal Guides, Executive Digest, IBTimes Colombia) and one third-party startup list (Future Feed), used only as "unconfirmed" leads unless the company is also on websummit.com. Filtered for relevance to us: AI-agent security and governance, identity, devtools for agents, GRC, Portugal, and a few investors and policy bodies. Homepage titles/meta descriptions were read for speakers' companies. First pass by the researcher on 1 November 2026: the first page of each official list only (partners, featured startups to 'Su', speakers, featured attendees); the rest of each list is loaded by the browser and was not read. Later wakes extend it. Second pass by the researcher on 1 November 2026: read the 40 LIS26 session pages listed in data/events.json (each carries conferenceSlug lis26 and names each speaker's organisation), the linked public /attendees/lis26/ pages and two /appearances/lis26/ pages, and each company's own homepage; added 29 speakers' companies in agent security, identity, AI governance, developer tools and Portugal, each confirmed by a session page. Third pass by the researcher on 1 November 2026: read the 40 further LIS26 session pages ws26-s41 to s80 in data/events.json, the linked public /attendees/lis26/ and four /appearances/lis26/ pages, and each company's robots.txt and then its homepage (title and description only), and added 21 speakers' companies in agent testing, AI governance and GRC, security, developer tools and Portugal, each confirmed by a session page.
